title: Generalized skew-gradient embedding for thermodynamically consistent systems
summary: The skew-gradient embedding (SGE) framework~\cite{GuWangSGE2025} reformulates a thermodynamically consistent system as a generalized gradient flow by embedding its zero-energy contribution in a skew-symmetric operator. In a time-discrete scheme, the profiles defining this operator may be evaluated at previous time levels. The resulting operator remains skew-symmetric, so its contribution to the discrete energy balance vanishes; this explicit treatment often decouples multiphysics systems.
